impacts.text: A user who has been blacklisted (e.g., for malicious activity) AFTER entering the cooldown period can still successfully withdraw their funds.
This completely negates the effectiveness of the blacklist for any funds that are already in the cooldown state.
this loophole renders the "freeze" capability ineffective during the most critical window.

ambiguities: Potential same vulnerability in direct unstake function in StakediTryV2 is noted but no distinct harmful outcome is expressly stated for it.
